# AquaSculpt (aquasculpt.onrender.com)

> aquasculpt.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about AquaSculpt, a daily vegetable capsule dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Form: vegetable capsule, 30 per bottle as pictured; the bottle says "Supports Healthy Weight Loss"; seller's directions: one capsule daily with a full glass of water in the morning
- Named ingredients: L-carnitine, berberine root, green tea extract, cayenne pepper, green coffee bean extract, L-theanine, resveratrol, chromium, milk thistle; no amounts given
- Price stated by the seller: $49 a bottle (called "regular" $153); 1, 3 and 6 bottle options; 6 bottles ship free; one-time payment; two bonus books with 3 and 6 bottles
- 60-day money-back guarantee; bottles, even empty ones, can be returned
- Not a treatment for obesity or any disease; berberine can interact with many medicines including diabetes medicine; green tea and green coffee extracts usually carry caffeine
